map.曝光值 EV 计算 使用指南: Exposure value EV calculation user guide
map.曝光值 EV 计算工具由光圈、快门、ISO 求 EV，同场景 EV 恒定，调整三: The EV calculator computes EV from aperture, shutter and ISO; in the same scene EV is constant, and adjusting the three must keep balance, suitable for understanding the exposure triangle and manual-mode practice.
map.统一 ISO100 基准比较不同感光度下曝光。: Unify ISO100 baseline to compare exposures at different sensitivities.
map.：EV11.9 加 +1 补偿：等效减一档快门或开一档光圈，画面提亮一倍。: : EV11.9 plus +1 compensation: equivalent to one stop faster shutter or one stop wider aperture, brightening the scene by a factor of two.
map.EV 含当前 ISO，EV@ISO100 归一到 ISO100 便于横向比较；差: EV includes the current ISO; EV@ISO100 normalizes to ISO100 for horizontal comparison; the difference = log2(ISO/100).
map.常规曝光成立，但极长/极短曝光有倒易律失效（需补偿），闪光与持续光也不同。: Normal exposure holds, but very long/very short exposure has reciprocity failure (needs compensation), and flash differs from continuous light.
